// A two-level sparse volume: a sparse set of dense cubic bricks, each
// BrickSize cells on a side. Regions with no brick are empty. Bricks are
// unique and sorted by ICoordinate (lexicographically Z, then Y, then X).
type BrickMap3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    BrickSize: Integer;
    Bricks: Array<VoxelBrick3D>;
}
